title: USA RV Park

services.name: RV site
services.desc: USA RV Park offers affordable nightly, weekly, and extended-stay rates for travelers visiting Gallup, New Mexico along historic Route 66. Conveniently located just off Interstate 40 with easy access from exits at mile markers 16 and 20, our park is a perfect stop for RV travelers passing through western New Mexico or exploring the surrounding Four Corners region. Whether you are staying for a night, a week, or longer, our full-hookup RV sites provide comfort, convenience, and quick access to local restaurants, shopping, and Gallup area attractions.
